version.description: Override Graylog and Graylog Data Node version (optional)

nameOverride.description: Override the name of the chart. Affects app.kubernetes.io/name annotation

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name.

global.description: Values shared across the Graylog, Data Node, and MongoDB workloads.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secret references used by all workloads to pull from private registries.

storageClass.description: Default StorageClass applied to PersistentVolumeClaims when a workload does not set its own.

existingSecretName.description: Name of existing Graylog secret containing GRAYLOG_MONGODB_URI, GRAYLOG_ROOT_USERNAME, GRAYLOG_PASSWORD_SECRET, and GRAYLOG_ROOT_PASSWORD_SHA2

enterprise.description: Use the Graylog Enterprise image and features. Set to false for Graylog Open.

replicas.description: Number of Graylog server replicas (StatefulSet pods).

service.description: Kubernetes Service exposing the Graylog server.

nameOverride.description: Override the generated name of the Graylog Service.

type.description: Kubernetes Service type (e.g. ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer).

ports.description: Ports exposed by the Graylog Service.

app.description: Port for the Graylog web interface and REST API.

enabled.description: Expose the Prometheus metrics port on the Service.

inputs.description: Graylog input ports to open on the Service. This only exposes the port; it does not create the input in Graylog.

name.description: Name of the input port (used as the Service port name).

targetPort.description: Container port the input listens on.

protocol.description: Network protocol for the port (TCP or UDP).

plugins.description: Graylog plugins to install at startup. Each entry must provide exactly one source: image, existingClaim, or url.

name.description: Plugin name (used to label the plugin volume/artifact).

image.description: Container image that provides the plugin .jar (mounted via an init container).

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC that contains the plugin .jar.

url.description: URL to download the plugin .jar from.

checksum.description: Expected checksum of the downloaded plugin, verified after download (requires url).

env.description: Key/value env vars rendered as literals

config.description: Graylog server configuration. These values can be found in server.conf

repository.description: Image repository. Leave empty to use the chart default for the selected edition.

tag.description: Image tag. Leave empty to use the chart appVersion / .Values.version.

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy (Always, IfNotPresent, or Never).

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secret references for the Graylog server image.

updateStrategy.description: StatefulSet update strategy for the Graylog server.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of pods that can be unavailable during the update.

partition.description: Ordinal at which to partition the rolling update; pods with a lower ordinal are not updated.

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the Graylog server container.

persistence.description: Persistent storage for the Graylog server.

enabled.description: Use a PersistentVolumeClaim for Graylog data. If false, an emptyDir is used.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the PVC. Falls back to global.storageClass when unset.

volumeNameOverride.description: Bind the PVC to a specific PersistentVolume by name.

existingClaim.description: Use an existing PVC instead of creating one.

mountPath.description: Path where the volume is mounted in the container.

selector.description: Label selector used to bind the PVC to a matching PersistentVolume.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe for the Graylog server container.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before the first probe.

periodSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe is considered failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe is considered successful.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe for the Graylog server container.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before the first probe.

periodSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe is considered failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe is considered successful.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number of pods that must remain available during voluntary disruptions.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext for the Graylog StatefulSet. Set to null to omit it entirely ({} is coalesced back to the chart defaults).

initContainerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext applied to the Graylog init containers. Set to null to omit it entirely ({} is coalesced back to the chart defaults).

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext applied to the graylog-app container. Set to null to omit it entirely ({} is coalesced back to the chart defaults).

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the Graylog server pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling the Graylog server pods.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for scheduling the Graylog server pods.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling the Graylog server pods.

enabled.description: Deploy the Graylog Data Node StatefulSet.

replicas.description: Number of Data Node replicas (StatefulSet pods).

service.description: Kubernetes Service exposing the Data Node.

ports.description: Ports exposed by the Data Node Service.

config.description: Graylog Data Node configuration (rendered into datanode.conf).
